parameters.help_en:
The ID of the application that you want to stop.

If you want to stop multiple applications at the same time, separate the IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
需要停止的应用ID。

如果同时需要停止多个应用，应用ID之间需要使用半角逗号（,）进行分割
parameters.name: app_ids

Code.description_en:
The HTTP status code. Take note of the following rules:

2xx: The call was successful.

3xx: The call was redirected.

4xx: The call failed.

5xx: A server error occurred
Code.description_zh:
接口状态或POP错误码。取值说明如下：

2xx：成功。
3xx：重定向。
4xx：请求错误。
5xx：服务器错误

Data.description_en: The ID of the change order

ChangeOrderId.description_en:
The error code.

If the request is successful, this parameter is not returned.\\

This parameter is returned only if the request failed.\\ For more information, see the "Error codes" section in this topic

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code returned if the request failed. Take note of the following rules:

The ErrorCode parameter is not returned if the request succeeds.

If the call fails, the ErrorCode parameter is returned. For more information, see the "Error codes" section of this topic
ErrorCode.description_zh:
错误码。取值说明如下：

请求成功：不返回ErrorCode字段。
请求失败：返回ErrorCode字段。具体信息，请参见本文的错误码列表

Message.description_en: The ID of the trace. It can be used to query the details of a request
Message.description_zh:
附加信息。取值说明如下：

请求正常，返回success。
请求异常，返回具体异常错误码

RequestId.description_en:
The returned message.

success is returned when the request succeeds.

An error code is returned when the request fails

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the application is created. Valid values

true

false
Success.description_zh:
批量停止应用是否成功。取值说明如下：

true：停止成功。
false：停止失败

TraceId.description_zh: 调用链ID，用于精确查询调用信息
